name: Barbell Hip Thrust with Pause
description: A barbell hip thrust performed with a deliberate pause at the top of each repetition. The pause eliminates elastic energy and forces the glutes to sustain maximum contraction isometrically, increasing time under tension and maximizing glute activation at peak hip extension.

execution.starting_position: Sit with your upper back against a flat bench, bar resting across your hips. Feet flat on the floor, knees bent approximately 90 degrees.
execution.setup_instructions: Roll the barbell over your legs and position it across your hip crease. Use a pad for comfort. Set up with the upper back on the bench edge.
steps: Step 1: Drive through both heels to thrust the hips upward.
Step 2: Extend the hips fully at the top, squeezing the glutes maximally.
Step 3: Hold the top position for 2 to 3 seconds while maintaining maximum glute contraction.
Step 4: Lower the hips back toward the floor under control and repeat.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale on the drive up and during the hold. Inhale on the way down.
common_mistakes: Hyperextending the lumbar spine at the top instead of using glute strength
Releasing the glute squeeze during the pause
safety_considerations: Keep the chin tucked — do not hyperextend the neck at the top
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full hip extension at the top — body forms a straight line from knees to shoulders. Hold this position.
coaching_cues: Squeeze the glutes hard at the top
Hold and breathe — do not relax
